_provenance.local_operation: deterministic SigGen via PKCS#11: C_CreateObject(CKO_PRIVATE_KEY, CKK_SLH_DSA, CKA_VALUE = upstream sk) then C_SignInit with CK_SIGN_ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT hedgeVariant = CKH_DETERMINISTIC_REQUIRED + upstream context (CKM_SLH_DSA, or CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash> for preHash), C_Sign; output byte-compared to the upstream signature
_provenance.transformation: subset only; every retained field is byte-copied from the upstream file; same upstream file (and sha256) as slhdsa_ctx_test.json
_provenance.subset_policy: Deterministic. SLH-DSA-SHA2-128f and SLH-DSA-SHAKE-128f only (the fastest parameter sets to sign; the deterministic pure 255-byte-context case for all 12 sets is already carried by slhdsa_ctx_test.json /sigGen). external/pure deterministic group -> the empty-context (0-byte) case with the shortest message; external/preHash deterministic group -> the case with the shortest message among hashAlg values that have a PKCS#11 v3.2 CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash> mechanism; ties by lowest tcId. Hedged groups (deterministic=false: the upstream additionalRandomness cannot be injected through CK_SIGN_ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT) and internal-interface groups are listed in notExecuted as metadata only.
_provenance.retained_fields: tcId, hashAlg, sk, pk, message, context, signature (deferred and additionalRandomness dropped)
_provenance.test_only_key_material: sk values are public NIST ACVP-Server sample data, imported into a session (CKA_TOKEN=false) object and destroyed after the case; they are not secrets
